snippet.title: House of Lost Souls — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The past is waiting behind the door.
Explore House of Lost Souls on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/

Watch the original announcement trailer for House of Lost Souls.

Jack returns to his old family home to uncover the truth about a tragedy from his childhood. An atmospheric first-person horror story from Arkuda Inc.

Subscribe for official trailers, gameplay and development updates.
